candidate_locked.stored_quantity: log(q/g), g=L+h_above-h_below, with analytic hydrostatic limit at g=0

fresh_ordinary_holdout.mapping: map each Sobol coordinate affinely into frozen effective-saturation envelope; then execute runtime state path S -> h -> u

special_holdout.equal_head_generation: heads = -geomspace(1,10000,96); convert h->S and runtime reconstruct S->h before lookup
special_holdout.hydrostatic_generation: h_above=-geomspace(11,10000,96), h_below=h_above+L when both remain in envelope; convert both h->S and runtime reconstruct
special_holdout.near_hydrostatic_generation: 64 h_above values from -geomspace(21,10000,64), each with h_below=h_above+L+epsilon for epsilon in {-1,+1} cm when in envelope; convert through S
special_holdout.wet_dry_cross_generation: Cartesian product of fixed normalized S fractions {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.5,0.9,0.97,0.99} mapped into the frozen S envelope
envelope_edge_probes: hydrostatic pairs nearest both admissible edges

decision_rule: PASS only if every B1-B6 criterion passes on the frozen unseen holdout and complete table generation succeeds. Any failed criterion rejects Gate B fail-closed; no retuning on these probes.
scope_guard: A holdout PASS qualifies only the first homogeneous unsaturated B01 10-cm face-law prototype. Gate C and all transient, saturation, heterogeneous, bottom-boundary, groundwater, process, MultiSWAP and FullRichards gates remain open.
